If the Nova Catalyst was a controlled demolition, the Nova Cataclysm is an apocalyptic weapon of mass destruction. By binding the primordial, eternal fire of Aeternalis Fuel into a highly unstable explosive core, you have created a device capable of leveling entire mountains in a blink of an eye. The sheer magnitude of this explosive force is terrifying, tearing apart the earth with unmatched fury. You hold the power of a dying star in your hands—use it with extreme caution.

Functionally, the Cataclysm unleashes a devastating explosion with a staggering 48-block radius, sweeping away almost everything in its path while retaining the item-gathering properties of its predecessor.

And before you get any bright ideas about industrial efficiency—no, you cannot use this as an explosive in a GregTech Implosion Compressor. The explosive yield is so catastrophically high that attempting to use it for gem or dust compression would instantly blow your incredibly expensive, hard-earned multiblock machine into a million scattered pieces. Keep this far, far away from your factory floor!
